gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-bassa-v: Conthrax is wide-mouthed and geometric, with no swelling in its bowls. Noto Sans Bassa Vah swallows most of each line's height in its midsection, with a c that gapes like pliers, so text moves along one steady thread.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Conthrax gives its lowercase a a wide mouth and holds every stroke to a single width. Noto Sans Buhid leaves generous gaps between curve ends and stems, while Conthrax does its best work in a few large words.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-cham: Clean and geometric, Conthrax draws every line like smooth tubing. Noto Sans Cham, a sans-serif with rounded lowercase and generously open c forms, keeps a paragraph flowing easily from line to line.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Level, wide and tidy: Conthrax keeps a quiet beat with no accents of weight. Noto Sans Deseret, an approachable sans with open apertures and squat ascenders, takes over the text where Conthrax leaves off.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-duploya: Noto Sans Duployan gives its lowercase a a wide mouth and oversized counters. Noto Sans Duployan handles the running text, while Conthrax, with no calligraphic shading, belongs on large display words.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Conthrax is geometric and clean, with stroke ends as wide as the middle and a wide-mouthed lowercase a. Noto Sans Elbasan adds large lowercase forms and terminals that never pinch shut below it.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-ethiopi: Smooth, wide and gently monotone: that is Conthrax. Conthrax is best as a display voice, while Noto Sans Ethiopic, a sans-serif with far-reaching c terminals and sturdy lowercase, does better carrying text.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-glagoli: Noto Sans Glagolitic reads clearly, with open round letters and a sturdy body. What stands out most is the gap between them: Conthrax runs one unmodulated line through every glyph, while the sans stays sturdy and open.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Bent-tubing letterforms, wide and geometric: that is the look of Conthrax up front. Noto Sans Grantha, a sans-serif with small flattened bowls that never close up, feels more pen-drawn beside it.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-gujarat: Wide, smooth and level: Conthrax keeps its horizontals no thinner than its verticals. And Noto Sans Gujarati, with curves that stop before turning inward and large open counters in a, e and s, keeps text moving smoothly.
